simple.summary: צְעִירָה (tsᵉʻîyrâh) means smallness (of age), i.e. juvenility First listed occurrence: Gen 43 33.

definitions.full: H6812. tseirah [ צְעִירָה ] noun feminine youth ; — suffix כִּצְעִרָתוֺ Gen 43:33 (J; opposed to כִּבְכֹרָתוֺ ). — On adjective צְעִירָה see foregoing; צעוריה Jer 48:4 צעוריהם 14:3 , see צָעִיר צֹעַר, .
